items.rationale: The fixed unit is insured under 4.2.3 and its lightning-surge damage falls under 2.3.3. At about seven metres from the hob it is outside the five-metre exclusion, so 7.1.9–7.1.10 allow an estimated €1,450 gross for like-for-like supply, excluding separately billed labour and freight.

Clause 2.3.10(c) excludes surge damage to climate-control equipment within five metres of a cooking appliance. This unit was about two metres from the hob and no endorsement applies, so the expected threshold is zero; €1,100 is the conditional gross supply estimate.
Clause 7.1.9(c) covers ordinary removal, fitting, connection and commissioning labour for the covered replacement. Allow about five technician hours at €90 gross per hour, or €450.
Under 7.1.11, installation follows the principal item, which is excluded by 2.3.10(c). The expected threshold is zero; if covered, four hours at €90 gross would give €360.

Clause 7.1.9(b) covers the equivalent support needed for the covered unit because the scorched original could not be reused. Allow €150 gross for a standard stand, with installation labour assessed separately.

Clauses 7.1.11–7.1.12 cover ordinary freight only in the covered proportion, subject to verification of the split. Using relative unit values in the absence of weight-based billing details, €110 gross × €1,450 / (€1,450 + €1,100) gives about €63.
